en-US.description: A local-first AI workspace for multi-agent chat, coding, and visual workflows.
en-US.longDescription: A local-first AI workspace for multi-agent chat, coding, and visual workflows. Available as a desktop app and self-hosted web console, with support for Hermes Agent, Ekko Agent, and 14 coding-agent integrations, including Claude Code and Codex. Bring conversations, group collaboration, voice, files, and devices together in one place.

zh-CN.description: 本地优先的 AI 工作区，支持多 Agent 聊天、编码和可视化工作流。
zh-CN.longDescription: 本地优先的 AI 工作区，支持多 Agent 聊天、编码和可视化工作流。提供桌面应用和可自托管的 Web 控制台，支持 Hermes Agent、Ekko Agent，以及包含 Claude Code、Codex 在内的 14 种 Coding Agent 集成。在同一个工作区中管理对话、群组协作、语音、文件和设备。
zh-CN.name: Ekko Studio
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
更新重点
- 统一 Studio 导航栏、页面标题和列表操作，优化移动端布局。
- 统一页面加载反馈，改进 Logo 加载动画及减少动态效果模式下的可见性。
- 优化自定义背景和毛玻璃层次，修复窗口边缘与圆角衔接，让麦克风按钮跟随主题配色。
- 按平台调整桌面窗口控制按钮的位置与样式，保留 Windows 原生窗口圆角。
- Gateway 自动启动改为显式开启，Profile 列表加载不再等待 CLI 检查，并修复消息气泡首次渲染。
- 用量统计新增费用记录与自定义模型单价，支持本地模型目录估算费用，改进模型上下文限制匹配。
- 修复 Agent 管理器中 Cursor 图标在浅色卡片上的显示。
What's Changed
- fix(cursor): use the product logo on Agent Manager cards by @KK-Skyline in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3222
- [codex] record usage costs and refresh local model pricing and limits by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3226
- [codex] unify Studio navigation, headers and mobile layouts by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3232
- [codex] make Gateway startup opt-in and unblock page initialization by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3233
- [codex] position desktop window controls by platform by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3234
- [codex] refine desktop window control placement and styling by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3235
- [codex] fix desktop theme surfaces, controls, and loading feedback by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3236
- chore: bump Studio and desktop to 0.7.26 with localized changelog by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3237
Full Changelog: https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/compare/v0.7.25...v0.7.26
